title: SQL injection in 60 seconds
caption: SQL injection in 60 seconds: the decades-old bug that still leaks databases, and the simple fix. #security #sql #webdev

scenes.title: SQL injection
scenes.say: One apostrophe in a login form can leak a whole database.
scenes.sub: One apostrophe in a login form can leak a whole database.

scenes.code:
query = "SELECT * FROM users
  WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
scenes.say: Build a query by gluing user input into a string, and the input becomes part of the code.

scenes.code:
name = ' OR '1'='1

SELECT * FROM users
  WHERE name = '' OR '1'='1'
scenes.say: Type a quote and a condition that's always true, and the query returns every user.
The fix is parameters. The query and the data travel separately, so input is never run as code.
That's SQL injection. Data is data, never code.
